current_path: Domain PulseCandidates -> 50 ms EnsembleMetricConsensus groups -> BeatReconstructionEngine -> BeatReferences -> EME association

origin_validation.runtime_origin_source: first ordered EnsembleMetricEvent.beat_time; arithmetic mean of the first 50 ms consensus group
origin_validation.reason: The centroid is observation-derived physical timing, but no authorized evidence assigns it quarter-note phase.
origin_validation.canonical_dataset_origin_declaration: MusicXML score time zero = WAV sample zero
origin_validation.mp3_origin_validation: NOT AUTHORIZED; CED-VAL-001 does not declare MP3 sample zero equivalent to score time zero

cardinality_validation.reason: BeatReference count is exactly the number of EnsembleMetricEvent consensus groups, not a count derived from declared temporal scope and period.
cardinality_validation.scope_defect: BeatReconstructionEngine receives no numeric analysis start/end and records only the generic string analysis_input.

common_timeline.reason: One BeatReference tuple is created per analysis and contributors associate afterward; no contributor-specific BeatReference collections exist.

source_density_independence.reason: The engine creates one BeatReference for every pre-EME consensus event, so changing transient/consensus density changes BeatReference count and supporting identities.

eme_dependency.reason: BeatReference reconstruction consumes pre-EME EnsembleMetricEvents and declared context, never ElementaryMetricEvents.

reproducibility.reason: Two complete runs produce identical timestamps but different BeatReference UUIDs because identity includes nondeterministic PulseCandidate UUIDs.

first_scientific_blocker: No authorized quarter-phase origin is supplied for the analyzed MP3, and the current consensus centroid is not metric-role evidence.
implementation_decision: No correction is scientifically authorized because satisfying the contract requires an explicit origin and numeric temporal-scope authority plus an association rule that does not derive movement count from observation density. None may be invented in this task.
